activities.name: Account Registration, Authentication & Identity Management
activities.purpose: Creating and authenticating user accounts, maintaining secure login sessions, and managing access rights across Web and Native platforms.
activities.proposedArticle6Basis: Art. 6(1)(b) Contract Performance (delivering authentication service requested by user)
activities.collectionSource: Direct user input via Signup / Login forms, Google OAuth, Apple Sign-In, Twilio WhatsApp OTP
activities.deletionPath: Initiated via `DELETE /api/user/delete` -> 30-day cancellation window in `deleted_accounts` -> Automated hard delete via `purgeDueDeletedAccounts()`
activities.securityControls: Bcrypt/Argon2 password hashing, JWT Bearer tokens, HTTPS/TLS 1.3, Supabase RLS, Row-Level isolation

activities.name: Spiritual Personalization & Religious Practice Profiling

activities.collectionSource: Direct user input during Onboarding questionnaire or Settings / Personal Details screens
activities.deletionPath: Directly editable/clearable in UI by user (setting fields to null) or cascading purge on Account Deletion
activities.securityControls: Supabase RLS locking base table from anonymous access; authenticated self-access only; column-level isolation

activities.deletionPath: User deletion of saved birth profile row, profile field reset, or full account deletion cascade
activities.securityControls: Server-side coordinate truncation, Age Guidance Notice display, RLS isolation

activities.name: Pramana AI Dharma Guidance, Scripture QA & Speech Synthesis (TTS)

activities.deletionPath: Transient stream discarded after delivery; cache TTL rotation
activities.securityControls: Prompt sanitization, strict RAG grounding in verified scripture, rate limiting, no training on user prompts under API agreement

activities.name: Ritual Reminders, Daily Panchang Push & Quiet Hours Delivery
activities.purpose: Dispatching timely reminder notifications for upcoming vrats, daily sunrise tithis, and auspicious muhurtas while respecting user quiet hours.

activities.deletionPath: Invalid token deletion on `DeviceNotRegistered` error, sign-out token wipe, or user preference toggle off

activities.name: Product Diagnostics, Performance Telemetry & Consented Web Advertising
activities.purpose: Monitoring platform performance, identifying rendering crashes, and serving non-personalized / personalized web advertisements only upon explicit consent.
activities.proposedArticle6Basis: Art. 6(1)(a) Consent (PECR / ePrivacy for Web Analytics & Ads) & Art. 6(1)(f) Legitimate Interests (essential crash diagnostics)
activities.collectionSource: Web Consent Manager banner, browser navigation events, Vercel edge telemetry
activities.storageLocation: Client cookie (`shoonaya_consent_v1`), Google Cloud / Vercel cloud analytics dashboards. Native Firebase Analytics is removed.

activities.securityControls: Prior-consent gating via `WebConsentManager.tsx`, zero ad SDKs in Native mobile build, IP anonymization enabled
